# Timelines and Basic Setup Info - PPR and API Go Live Jan 25th

_Category: Announcements · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**trish.reimer** (12/23/2021):

Getting started with BC Registries APIs

1. View [API Services](https://developer.bcregistry.daxiom.ca/apis-summary/) and read the specifications to find the ones that meet your needs.
2. Create a [BC Registriesâ€™ premium account](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/assets/gov/employment-business-and-economic-development/business-management/permits-licences-and-registration/registries-other-assets/create_and_manage_an_account_in_the_bc_registry.pdf) to gain access (if you have not already done so).
3. Download the [API Terms of Use.pdf](https://developer.bcregistry.daxiom.ca/api-terms-of-use.pdf) and submit an access request email to [[REDACTED_EMAIL]](mailto:[REDACTED_EMAIL]). In your email, please include:
* Signed API Terms of Use
* BC Registries premium account number (note your account number located in the Account Settings).
4. Upon completion of the access request, you will be issued with a sandbox environment API key with the appropriate access.
5. Test your provided sandbox environment API key.
6. If you're done testing, request a production environment API key to [[REDACTED_EMAIL]](mailto:[REDACTED_EMAIL]).
7. You will be issued with a production environment API key via email.
